_note: Ceilings, never exact figures: a change that fits needs no edit here. Raise one only with the reason in the commit message.

doom_wasm_bytes.why: README promises under 300 KB of wasm

heap_base_bytes.why: __heap_base: stack + DATA + BSS below the heap. INITIAL_MEMORY is a fixed 32 MB with no growth, and the WADs are malloc'd above this line, so every byte here comes out of PWAD headroom

payload_gzip_bytes.why: cold page load: every sw.js SHELL_FILES entry, gzip -9

surface_gzip_bytes.why: the same without the engine: JS + CSS + HTML
